spans.s:
Unconquered.
2

Unexcelled, unsurpassed.
m. (-तः)
1 The second of the twenty-four principal Jaina Tīrthakaras or deified sages.
2 A name of VIṢṆ
A name of

BUDDHA.
4

A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अ neg. and जित, participle of जि to conquer.

n. (-नं)
A hide used as a seat, bed, &c. by the religious student; generally the hide of an antelope.
E.
अज to go, and the Uṇādi aff. इनच्.

f. (-त्रा-त्री)
A bat.
E.
अजिन a hide, and पत्र a wing.

m. (-निः)
A deer, or antelope.
E.
अजिन a hide, and योनि place or origin.

n. (-रं)
1 A court or yard.
2 Air, wind.
3 The body.
4 An object of sense.
5 A frog.
E.
अज to go, and किरन् aff.

mfn. (-ह्मः-ह्मा-ह्मं)
Straight, not crooked, literally or metaphorically; upright, sincere, honest, direct.
m. (-ह्मः)
A frog.
E.
अ neg. and जिह्म crooked.

m. (-गः)
An arrow.
mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Going or moving in a straight line.
E.
अजिह्म straight, direct, and ग what goes.

mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं)
Tongueless, having no tongue.
m. (-ह्वः)
A frog.
E.
अ neg. and जिह्व from जिह्वा a tongue.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A Ṛṣi, the father of Śunaḥśepha.

n. (-र्णः)
1 Flatulency, indigestion.
2 Vigour, absence of old age or decay.
mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1

Undigested.
2

Undecayed, unimpaired.
E.
अ neg. and जीर्ण old, digested.

Death.
2

Non-existence.
mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Lifeless, dead.
E.
अ neg. and जीव life.

m. (-वः)
Livelihood, subsistence.
E.
आङ्, जीव to live, घञ् aff.

f. (-निः)
Non-existence; used as an imprecation. See अकरणि, अजीवनिस्तस्य भूयात्.
E.
अ neg. जीव and अनि aff.

f. (-जिः)
1 War, battle.
2 Level ground.
3 An instant.
4 Abuse, reviling.
5 Going.
E.
अज to go, इन् Uṇādi affix, and आङ् prefixed or अज with इण् aff.

f. (-या)
Fighting, making war.
E.
आजि and क्रिया act.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Ambitious, desirous to excel or overcome.
E.
आङ् before जि to conquer, in the desiderative form, affix उस.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
What takes or seizes.
E.
आङ् before ग्रह to take, श aff.

n. (-नं)
Livelihood.
E.
आङ् before जीव to live, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-र्थं)
Means of livelihood or subsistence, business, profession.
E.
आजीवन and अर्थ means.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Habitable, fertile.
2 To be practised as a means of living.
E.
आङ् before जीव्य to be lived, in or by.
